column1: # Historical foundry CapEx and transistor cost scaling estimates across process nodes.
# Transcribed from industry consensus analyses by International Business Strategies (IBS)
# and Gartner semiconductor research reports (2014-2023). CapEx represents representative
# greenfield leading-edge gigafab capital expenditure per node. Cost per billion
# transistors reflects processed wafer pricing divided by effective yielded logic density.
# These values are macro-economic industry estimates
# They serve as a stylized comparison of the 28nm cost-per-transistor inflection.
# For primary SEC EDGAR 10-K financial filings
